evidence_scope: Static native consumers and shipped manifests; no runtime interoperability test

http_contract.request_transport: Direct NETGCloudSpace coroutine calls AES.Encrypt6a32c0, which internally appends #platformName before UTF8/AES; then Uri.EscapeDataString

response_fields.name: asset_IDs
response_fields.rule: skip empty tokens; every nonempty token is an asset ID

http_contract.native_acceptance: Menu must still be active; empty list invokes menu empty callback, otherwise AddPetAssets/AddLocomotionAssets receives list.
http_contract.identifier_rules: Use original-case canonical prefab IDs, not lowercase bundle names. Do not send a count, gender, display name or nonempty trailer.

local_policy.ownership: Only explicit offline resource_admin grants; no payment or Steam order processing
local_policy.storage: resource_entitlements SQLite table keyed ps4_id,kind,item_id; independent of wardrobe entitlements
local_policy.default_grants: none; empty is an exact supported DTO
local_policy.ordering: deterministic item_id order; original server order unavailable
local_policy.display_names: local explicit label or item ID fallback; commercial labels unrecovered

limitations: Shipped availability does not prove original ownership, prices, unlock policy or default grants.
Manifest dependencies retain developer build-drive prefixes; runtime loader resolution has not been exercised.
Canonical paths and thumbnails are verified statically; successful instantiation, AI/animation and multiplayer synchronization remain untested.
Excluded nested dependency prefabs and three wardrobe FBX bundles under03 must not be independently granted as locomotions.

conflicts: Thumbnail bundle identity conflicts with native item ID
